content.comment_body: Hello, I have two [product_name] devices with different [article_no] versions. When I upload a program to one device, it works correctly, but on the second device, the same process fails whether I use Ethernet or SD card. The upload appears to complete, but when starting the program, it shows: Error: Empty program. The second device is new, and all settings are identical. Does anyone have any ideas on the cause? Thanks!

It is likely your first [product_name] is a [article_no] Standard version, while the new one is a [product_name] FS04. Device selection must be matched in the program, and the FS04 can only be edited with [product_name] [version_no]. Any reason you can't download programs to the new FS04 device?
Issue resolved: Firmware version FW 1.81.01 only works with [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience errors when uploading programs to newer [product_name] devices due to firmware and software version incompatibility. Specifically, devices with FW 1.81.01 require [product_name] [version_no] for successful uploads. This highlights the importance of firmware and software version alignment and proper device selection in programming processes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that programs can be uploaded and started on any [product_name] device with the same [article_no], regardless of firmware version, using standard upload methods and current software.
